title: Software Engineer - Backend
responsibilities: Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs.
Implement scalable application features using Python and FastAPI.
Write unit tests and maintain code quality.
Work with databases to design and optimize data access.
Collaborate with frontend engineers and other members of the engineering team.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
description: We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our backend engineering team. The role is suitable for an early-career software engineer who is interested in developing backend services and APIs using Python. The candidate will work closely with experienced engineers to build, test, and maintain production software.
